pool.text: The city of Pyongyang had a total population of forty thousand inhabitants.
Japan faced the March First Movement during its colonial rule.
Anti-Chinese riots occurred in July due to the Wanpaoshan Incident.
The population of Pyongyang reached a total of two hundred thirty-five thousand.
The Soviet 25th Army entered the city as it became a temporary capital.
Kim Il Sung University, the oldest university in North Korea, was established.
Pyongyang became the de facto capital of North Korea.
South Korean forces briefly occupied the city during the Korean War.
The city faced the largest aerial raid of the entire war.
The master plan designed by Kim Jung-hee was officially adopted.
Archaeologists excavated evidence of prehistoric dwellings in a large ancient village.
The new constitution officially declared Pyongyang as the official capital.
A structure containing twenty-five thousand five hundred granite blocks was completed.
The funeral of Kim Il Sung took place in the city.
North Korean authorities initiated a long-term modernisation programme.
A residential project with 2,784 units was inaugurated on Changjon Street.
A second phase of the power expansion project was launched.
Units were built in the new Ryomyong Street complex for a birthday.
Apartment blocks in specific districts were demolished for new buildings.
Construction started on a new medical facility named Pyongyang General Hospital.
